mapper.sql: revert_id, eco_id, revert_type, reverted_on, note, status, void_reason, voided_at, voided_by, row_ver, created_at, created_by
effect_id, eco_id, result, note, base_date, basis_n, basis_days, status, void_reason, voided_at, voided_by, row_ver, created_at, created_by
mapper.select: select from qms_change_revert where eco_id = #{ecoId} order by revert_id desc
select from qms_change_effect where eco_id = #{ecoId} order by effect_id desc
insert into qms_change_revert (comp_cd, eco_id, revert_type, reverted_on, note, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{ecoId}, #{type}, #{on}, #{note}, #{by}, #{by}) returning revert_id

insert into qms_change_effect (comp_cd, eco_id, result, note, base_date, basis_n, basis_days, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{ecoId}, #{result}, #{note}, #{base}, #{n}, #{days}, #{by}, #{by}) returning effect_id
select c.eco_id from qms_change c where c.revert_cond is not null and not exists (select 1 from qms_change_revert r where r.eco_id = c.eco_id and r.status = 'ACTIVE') order by c.eco_id limit #{limit}

select x.line_no, ch.char_id, coalesce(i.item_cd, p.proc_cd) || '-' || ch.char_no as ref_label, ch.char_nm, ch.data_type, ch.lsl, ch.usl, ch.scale, ch.unit_nm, ch.item_id, ch.proc_id from qms_change_char x join qms_char ch on ch.char_id = x.char_id left join mst_item i on i.item_id = ch.item_id left join mst_proc p on p.proc_id = ch.proc_id where x.eco_id = #{ecoId} order by x.line_no

select i.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.unit_cd, (select count(*) from qms_insp h where h.item_id = i.item_id and h.status = 'JUDGED' and h.occurred_at >= #{from} and h.occurred_at < #{to}) as insp_cnt, (select count(*) from qms_insp h where h.item_id = i.item_id and h.status = 'JUDGED' and h.result = 'NG' and h.occurred_at >= #{from} and h.occurred_at < #{to}) as insp_ng, (select count(*) from qms_ncr n where n.item_id = i.item_id and n.status <> 'CANCELLED' and n.occurred_at >= #{from} and n.occurred_at < #{to}) as ncr_cnt, (select coalesce(sum(n.nc_qty), 0) from qms_ncr n where n.item_id = i.item_id and n.status <> 'CANCELLED' and n.occurred_at >= #{from} and n.occurred_at < #{to}) as ncr_qty from mst_item i where i.item_id in #{x} order by i.item_cd
